  PROBLEM: In Auto mode, evaluate() returns (None, "") for shell-shape doubts (ValueError path, hidden gh api, shell rewrite hazard, unquoted expansion), so the allow rules `Bash(gh api repos/*)` and `Bash(gh api user *)` (settings.json:29-30, and workflow-templates/.claude/settings.json:29-30) auto-approve those commands with no prompt and no classifier.
  WHY: The guard's ask used to override the allow rule, so hidden writes such as `gh api repos/o/r/pulls/$(gh api -X DELETE ...)` and test cases like `gh api repos/o/r/pulls/{1,2}` now run unprompted. Severity is MAJOR in all six reviewers; the highest label is used here and no reviewer disagreed.
- CLAUDE.md:§23.H "Auto mode" paragraph and §23.D item 4; changelog.d/auto-mode-hook-prompts.md; agents.d/auto-mode-hook-prompts.md; gh_api_write_guard.py module docstring | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The docs say the Auto-mode classifier judges shape-doubt commands, but for commands matching the shipped allow rules the allow rule decides first and auto-approves.
  WHY: Consumers receive the changed hook together with the settings.json that has the allow rule, so the documented safety net does not apply. Reviewers marked this MAJOR, and the same root cause is reported in the first finding.
- .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:~1137-1158 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The Auto-mode deny reason for missing stamps includes "Set CLAUDE_PREPUSH_TEST_GATE=off to disable this check.", which an autonomous session can follow to turn the gate off.
  WHY: This is a hardening suggestion (risk scores 1-3), not a confirmed defect, so the severity here is an assumption.

  WHY: Auto-mode sessions can run shape-doubt `gh api repos/...` commands with no prompt and no classifier review.

The allow rules `Bash(gh api repos/*)` and `Bash(gh api user *)` (.claude/settings.json:29-30, and workflow-templates/.claude/settings.json:29-30) then auto-approve any such command, including `gh api repos/o/r/pulls/{1,2}` and `gh api repos/o/r/pulls/1 'unterminated`.
